decision: Reject the preregistered BTC/SOL 15-minute EMA5 speed-continuation mechanism. Do not open validation or holdout, do not retune EMA periods, stops, or hold time to rescue it, and do not change V57.

frozen_mechanism.entry: fresh completed-close EMA5 recross while EMA5, EMA21, and EMA55 are strictly trend ordered
frozen_mechanism.fill: next 15-minute bar first exact L2 ask or bid plus declared residual slippage
frozen_mechanism.stop: prior eight completed bars clamped to 80 bps maximum distance

pooled_development.scenario_trade_count_note: Residual slippage changes next-bar barrier validity and subsequent position occupancy, so nominal and stress trade counts differ by three; this is explicit path dependence, not pooled row loss.

symbol_diagnostics.interpretation: Both assets and both directions fail independently; the rejection is not caused by one asset, side, fold, or winner.

execution_and_path_evidence.interpretation: Technical uncertainty cannot rescue the candidate because the observed economic failure is large, consistent across folds and sides, and worsens under stress.

diagnosis.primary: The fast EMA recross fires far too often in ordinary 15-minute noise. Gross continuation is insufficient to overcome spread, taker fees, residual slippage, and repeated rapid signal exits.
not_supported: normal variance around a small positive edge
largest-winner dependence as the sole problem
a live execution bug as the cause of these development results
diagnosis.implementation_incident: The first run detected a same-bar lifecycle ordering adapter defect and published nothing. A failing regression was added; same-bar exits now serialize at entry plus one millisecond for shared-account ordering. Seventeen focused tests passed before the controlled rerun.

confidence.basis: One frozen year, 4285 nominal pooled lifecycles, three losing chronological folds, both directions and both symbols negative, realistic taker fees and exact next-boundary BBO, adverse stress, and largest-winner removal.
confidence.limitations: Exact historical mark truth is absent and 361 lifecycles overlap incomplete L2 path bars, so liquidation chronology is not qualification-grade; this uncertainty would matter to a marginal positive result but does not plausibly reverse the observed large negative economics.

reopen_condition: Do not reopen this EMA5 recross family through period, stop, hold, or side retuning. Only materially new causal information, a separately preregistered mechanism, or validated changed-regime evidence may justify a new hypothesis.

highest_value_next_investigation.action: Continue exact active-route HYPE both-side eligible-decision and fully resolved lifecycle collection.
highest_value_next_investigation.reason: It is already live, source-compatible, and directly closes the current identity-to-economics evidence gap without changing parameters or inventing another high-turnover mechanism.

falsifiers: Independent reconstruction from the immutable sidecar does not reproduce the pooled, fold, side, or symbol metrics.
The executed signal logic differs from the preregistered completed-close EMA5 recross and EMA5/21/55 ordering contract.
The validation or holdout interval influenced parameter selection or development disposition.
A material accounting or same-bar ordering defect remains after the focused regression and changes the direction of all three folds.
